description: Upload a .ipa to App Store Connect via Transporter on the replay host. For CI/Expo-built apps, upload the .ipa through Expo or your CI pipeline directly and skip this tool — it exists only for builds that must be uploaded from the replay host itself. Supply ipa_url (https) or the host-local ipa_path.

ipa_path.description: Legacy path on replay host or https URL

ipa_url.description: https URL to download signed .ipa before Transporter upload

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: upload_build
